prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a medieval stone dungeon torture chamber with rough-cut stone block walls on each side of her, a low vaulted stone ceiling, iron torch sconces with flickering flames on the walls, old iron tools hanging on the stone wall, a damp flagstone floor, dark and moody firelight, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking in from one side, sharp focus from head to toe, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Subject: ONE real adult Italian woman in her mid 30s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, warm olive skin, thick strongly arched dark brows, a long black liner winging up and out at the outer corner of each eye, soft brown eyeshadow, long lashes, large dark eyes with bright real catchlights, a deep red lip with a subtle grimace of effort, a small crease between her brows and her jaw set just a little, deep reddish mahogany-brown hair styled in vintage victory rolls framing the face, real living eyes. Long round nails, chrome finish.

Physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. a professional female bodybuilder physique carrying around 230 pounds of dense, hard, fully developed muscle, with the most extreme glute and hip development. Gigantic rounded shoulders with visible separation between the front, side and rear deltoids, thick swollen biceps and triceps with a deep split between them, wide flaring lats, a deeply carved abdomen with sharp obliques, colossal glutes and hips so massively muscular they extend far beyond the shoulders, gigantic quadriceps with a deep outer sweep and a visible teardrop shape above each knee, thick hamstrings, and diamond-shaped calves. The waist is narrow only in contrast to the massive hips and shoulders. Every muscle group is separated by deep grooves and hard edges. Hard and muscular, not soft, not a plus-size body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Skin: Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a smooth taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh folds, faint stretch marks where the great curves have expanded. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Korean najeon mother-of-pearl lacquer — glossy black lacquer with shimmering mother-of-pearl vines, wide mother-of-pearl bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense scrollwork filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers her body below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line. The glaze has faded and dulled in patches, rubbed thin over her elbows, knees and shins and chipped away in small flakes along her thighs and forearms, so her warm living skin shows through the worn pattern here and there. A grey film of dust and soot dulls her face, her mascara is smeared under her eyes, grime is rubbed into her shoulders, forearms and thighs, and her bare feet are filthy with dust and dirt.

Restraints: Her ankles wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, each ankle fetter joined by its own short heavy chain of massive thick black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb, to one single huge black iron ring held low between her feet, so that the two ankle chains run from her two ankles and meet at that one ring. She wears a heavy medieval iron neck ring of wide rough-forged wrought iron, closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, with a heavy iron ring at the front, snug around her neck, from which a heavy chain of massive thick black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb, hangs straight down the front of her body and is joined to that same ring between her feet, so that the neck chain and both ankle chains all meet at that one ring, the long chain hanging in a gentle slack curve.

Pose: standing full height, facing the camera, her feet a hand's width apart, her arms relaxed at her sides, the long chain hanging down the center of her body to the ring between her feet in view, her chest, shoulders and stomach fully in view.

Footwear: bare feet flat on the floor, the soles, toes and tops of her feet streaked with soot and dirt.

Background & Lighting: the dim light catching the painted pattern in sharp glints, carving every fold and curve.
